title: Chainsaw Games
description: A small minigame server, with custom made games!
body:
# Chainsaw Games
We are a small community that make our own games, primarily for the Java Realms platform. However, we also host our own server!

Currently, the games we have on the server include DuelTNT and Bleps: Nocked and Loaded.

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/N3ES9SBkIPs" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

While we are too small of a community to constantly be online, we have dedicated matchmaking roles on our [Discord Server](https://discord.gg/sUMzeupBNG). Just grab Bleps Matchmaking or DuelTNT Matchmaking, ping the role, and someone will gladly jump on and play.
